source_query:
SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(page.id ORDER BY page.id),'{}'::text[]) INTO scan_ids FROM
      (SELECT task.id FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 task WHERE task.id<=scan_upper ORDER BY task.id LIMIT 500) page;
bound_query:
SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(page.id ORDER BY page.id),'{}'::text[]) FROM
      (SELECT task.id FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 task WHERE task.id<=$1 ORDER BY task.id LIMIT 500) page
derivation: Remove only INTO scan_ids and bind existing scan_upper to typed text parameter$1; preserve all other query bytes. Upper lookup is the exact existing candidate PK DESC LIMIT1 statement with its local variable renamed.
measurement_limits: Measures the first finite ID-page access path only. Does not measure per-ID loops, snapshots, later accounting/sealer or prove source acquisition resumed.
